prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background matte painting for an atmospheric 2D/3D exploration game, landscape 3:2 format. A huge alien world of massive suspended mineral carapaces and broad layered continental shelves receding into an immense dark violet-grey void. This is a ruined overwritten reality, oppressive but beautiful, nothing human-built. Strong asymmetrical painterly composition: one enormous slanted layered rock-body enters from the upper left, a broad disconnected continental mass fades in the upper right, beneath them two much smaller distant silhouettes show enormous scale; plenty of quiet open space through the center and lower third for the game foreground. NOT an interwoven lattice or a net. NOT thin bridges. Broad bodies with weight and clear planar overlap. Art direction: sophisticated hand-painted gouache animation background, deliberate large clean shapes, simplified three-tone form shading, broken selective contour accents, smoothly designed silhouette edges. Palette restrained muted slate plum, dusty dark mauve, desaturated iron ochre edge accents. Middle values around dark slate; no solid black field, no white. The far bodies are lower contrast and less detailed than the near ones. No photographic rock textures, no grain/noise coating, no embossed crack texture, no intricate fibrous greebles. No cumulus clouds, no blue sky, no sunshine, no sun disc, no golden heavenly cloudscape, no stars. Depth conveyed by progressively muted silhouettes in still thin atmospheric medium. No foreground playable platforms, no characters, text, UI, border, logo. This raster will be used only at far distance behind actual 3D sculpted terrain.
postprocessing: none; runtime atmospheric color only; never used as foreground surface texture
